messages:
ana: Lattice (prospect) asked for a short perf validation before final terms. Goal: sustain 1.6k req/s steady, allow 3.5k bursts for ~5m, avg output ~180 tokens, p95 target <=420ms. They also want a Dedicated baseline and security checklist up-front. Call Thurs AM.
mike: Clarify: single-turn or chat? hosted preferred?
wana: Single-turn, prompts ~140-200 tokens. Hosted fine but they explicitly want Dedicated pricing.
jon: I'll run the bench. Quick plan: warm 5m -> 400rps, steps 400->800->1.2k->1.6k->2.5k->3.5k (4-5m each), sustain 15m at 1.6k, short 5m spike to 3.5k. Models: 13B-q4 & 34B-q4. Batch sizes [8,12]. KV cache on/off. Add X-Req-Id + token headers.
perf-bot: queued perf-lattice-7250 on cluster=perf-bench, workers=64, eta=2m
sara: curl smoke for deck: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":180,"batch_size":8}'
jon: Smoke (13B-q4 batch=12 kv_cache off): p50=150ms p95=700ms p99=980ms errs=1.5% (timeouts near 2.5k). Observed worker ingress queueing.
mike: Try batch=8 and 34B-q4. Lower batching usually helps tail.
jon: Rerun 13B-q4 batch=8: p50=210ms p95=460ms p99=760ms errs=0.3% sustained 15m at 1.6k. Spike to 3.5k produced transient 503s but recovered.
jon: 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=190ms p95=400ms p99=680ms errs=0.4% (higher mem per host).
sara: KV cache hit rate low (~9%) for their prompt set, not helpful for baseline.
sec-bot: Lattice asks: CMEK/KMS, SOC2, VPC peering for Dedicated. We support AWS/GCP KMS, SOC2 PDF available, Dedicated supports VPC peering; hosted can use private endpoints & allowlists. Need key-rotation test window. SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf
mike: Quick cost sketch (prelim): Hosted: steady 1.6k rps, avg 180 tok -> est ~$46k/mo. Dedicated: reserved fleet (~8 A100-eq) amortized infra ~$28k/mo + platform fee -> quote ~$34k-$37k/mo with SLA 99.9% and better p95.
nana: Sales asks for one-slide: numbers + p95/p99 charts, cost ranges hosted vs dedicated, and security checklist. Jon to upload grafana + logs. Sec-bot to supply KMS checklist.
jon: Uploading artifacts to perf/7250001111/ (logs + grafana). Will paste links in invite.
nana: Action items: sec-bot KMS checklist EOD, jon single-slide + artifacts by Wed noon, mike draft Dedicated quote by Wed EOD, Ill book Thurs AM. :thumbsup:
